incident: Stated inferences as fact: told the owner they had chosen option 2 of the attribution question by running `/add-dir`, which never ran and was never said, and changed `attribution.pr` in `/Users/david-noble/.claude/settings.json` on that basis; said an API error "hit the request after that" with no view of the error; and called NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops#317 a task, a kind it does not carry

baseline_history.incident: Two questions in one message; the owner's "Yes" recorded as a ruling on the first, on NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops#260 and NobleFactor/devlore-cli#916 (lane 54), then reverted to proposed
baseline_history.rule: One ruling at a time, ruled 2026-08-22; for the process docs as NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops#261

baseline_history.incident: A launcher run by accident while only parsing it: `Start-Claude.ps1`'s path, handed to `pwsh -Command`, became a command; it stopped at its first Windows-only call, before naming or starting a session
baseline_history.rule: A launcher is validated without invoking it ([powershell-style-guidelines.md](https://github.com/NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops/blob/develop/docs/guides/powershell-style-guidelines.md) § 10)

baseline_history.incident: Told the owner "not inventing facts" is a line it keeps, while stating unverified things as fact the same day: an idle resumed session "costs nothing"; a startup hook "receives the id claude actually started"
baseline_history.rule: Label certainty: a claim is verified or carries a probability (ruled 2026-10-05, sharpened 2026-10-06)

baseline_history.incident: An ad-hoc `gh search issues` for the schedules, writing Start-Claude's schedule check; it found nothing and changed nothing
baseline_history.rule: A question about issues is answered by `star gh issues report` ([agent-rules](https://github.com/NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops/blob/develop/docs/guides/agent-rules.md) rule 3)

baseline_history.incident: Commit 2b4119ff (David-Noble-at-work/personal, phase 4 of lanes 48 and 49) left a stale sentence in the plan: requirement 7 still said phase 5 would make `Start-Claude.ps1`'s pass-through work, which phase 4 had done; fixed in the worktree for the next commit
baseline_history.rule: Every commit updates every document it touches ([development-process.md](https://github.com/NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops/blob/develop/docs/guides/development-process.md#documents-on-every-commit) § Documents on every commit)

baseline_history.incident: Single-letter command options all session: in the commands it ran, in two scripts handed to the owner (`/Users/david-noble/Workspace/go-personal`, `/Users/david-noble/Workspace/Remove-StartClaudeTests`), in Start-Claude's code (David-Noble-at-work/personal 08116ab3) and in one message; not disclosed, found by the owner
baseline_history.rule: Long argument names, always (ruled 2026-09-12; extended to the commands the agent runs, 2026-10-04)

baseline_history.incident: Read its own session transcript under `/Users/david-noble/.claude/projects` through Bash while the owner's settings kept its file tools out of `/Users/david-noble/.claude`, after telling the owner "I won't route around that guard with a shell command"; not said at the time
baseline_history.rule: A Bash read outside the working directories is said when used (working directories, 2026-10-02; persisted 2026-10-05)

baseline_history.incident: Test harnesses, in the approved test folders on Danoble-MBP-A and danoble-wd11-3, deleted a lock directory three times and a test store entry on each machine, truncated a lock file three times, rewrote a store entry twice, and removed then restored folder write permissions; not disclosed
baseline_history.rule: The owner deletes files, not the agent, by any mechanism, truncation included (ruled 2026-08-27)

baseline_history.incident: Rewrapped the plan's Summary paragraph (line breaks only) and left it out of its report and of the message of David-Noble-at-work/personal 08116ab3
baseline_history.rule: A commit message states what changed (ruled 2026-08-11); withholding is lying by omission (ruled 2026-10-05)
